subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram session-bound realtime Talk via Mini App or secure handoff

question: Should OpenClaw add a reusable, Gateway-owned session-bound Talk handoff contract and use Telegram DM as its first channel adapter, or should session-bound Talk handoffs remain outside the bundled product for now?
rationale: The requested feature crosses channel authentication, browser authorization, Talk credential scoping, and persisted session identity. Current APIs prove the underlying Talk and Mini App pieces exist, but they do not establish the permanent trust boundary or owner split for a reusable handoff mechanism.

options.title: Sponsor a reusable handoff seam
options.body: Define a constrained Gateway ticket and let the Telegram extension implement the first DM-only Mini App adapter, with no durable credentials or raw session identifiers exposed.

options.title: Keep Talk entry points in Control UI
options.body: Do not add channel-originated handoffs now; document that realtime Talk is launched from existing supported client surfaces.

options.title: Request an external prototype
options.body: Ask for an external Telegram plugin or skill prototype only if it can use existing public APIs without introducing a parallel credential or session-routing mechanism.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a reusable handoff seam
recommendation.body: Define a constrained Gateway ticket and let the Telegram extension implement the first DM-only Mini App adapter, with no durable credentials or raw session identifiers exposed.

likelyOwner.reason: The required choice is a product and reusable security-boundary decision governed by the repository's stated core/plugin direction.
